hook: Your trip to Saturn would show a two-toned moon.
title: Saturn's Moon: Coal Black and Snow White
description:
Iapetus, a moon of Saturn, is dark on one side and bright on the other. Cassini photos show it clearly, along with a huge ridge running around its equator that makes it look like a walnut. Part of the series If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #Saturn
